text: Every Gromark rule tried so far adds earlier digits. Multiplying them is the other simple rule, and the raised YAR has been read as starting digits.
Every pair of earlier positions up to six back, every base from 2 to 16 and 26, every starting run, four ways of applying the digit, any mixed alphabet.
Nothing fits K4 or a scrambled copy; planted texts are found. F5.1 closed.
